description:
Real aggregation endpoints with filter-before-export, product performance by brand, and server-side masking that actually fires.

Epic: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/epics.md (Epic 5)
Architecture: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture.md
Requires: W2 merged (read models), W3 merged (suppliers and category)
Blocks: nothing

userStories.title: Extract the hardened CSV writer to src/lib/csv.js
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one CSV writer, so that the formula-injection guard is not forked.
acceptanceCriteria: FORMULA_PREFIXES, csvCell and csvRow move verbatim, comments included
trade-price-lists.js imports them and keeps CSV_HEADER and csvFilename unchanged
test/price-list-exposure.test.js passes untouched — that is the proof this was a move
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Migration: reporting index and finance access
userStories.description: As the platform, I want date-ranged reports to scan efficiently and finance visibility to be explicit.
acceptanceCriteria: An index on orders.created_at — the date range is the primary scan and only user_id and status are indexed today
users.can_view_finance boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, backfilled true for directors
It joins the PATCH whitelist with the same discipline as trade_approved: moving a role off backoffice/director clears it
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Report filter layer
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want to narrow a report before I export it.
acceptanceCriteria: A frozen whitelist maps filter names to trusted columns; values are always $n placeholders
Filters: from, to, brand (multi), product_type, collection, kind, status
The module is pure with no database access and is unit-tested
An unknown filter name is ignored; an invalid value is a 400 naming it
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Revenue scope CTE and the masking module
userStories.description: As a director, I want cost figures hidden from staff who may not see them.
acceptanceCriteria: The scope CTE is the seam where future D365 line data unions in
Default population is status IN (paid, shipped), all kinds, overridable by filter
Request-kind lines contribute quantity at zero value with an unpriced_lines count
Finance columns are DELETED from columns, every row and totals — not nulled
meta.masked_columns carries labels only
A finance-end-to-end report answers 403 with a reason, never 200 with an empty table
Access is derived from request.user only — never a query param, header or body value
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Product performance by brand
userStories.description: As a director, I want to see which houses and designs sell, so that buying decisions have evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Grouped by brand and product, summing qty and qty x unit_price_cents
The response envelope is consumable by the CRM buildReport cell pipeline without rewriting reportBuilders.js
The payload states its coverage window and that historic D365 data is header-only, so no pre-launch sale is included
Rate-limited
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Server-side CSV export
userStories.description: As back-office staff, I want the exported file to match what I filtered.
acceptanceCriteria: The export shares one query builder with the table, so they cannot disagree
It is NOT limited to the current page
export.csv is its own path segment, never a suffix on a param
maskReport runs before the writer sees a row; a non-finance caller gets no finance header
A product name beginning = is neutralised
A tighter rate-limit bucket than the read routes
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Stock and not-invoiced reports
userStories.description: As the office, I want the two live-data reports the current fixtures only pretend to show.
acceptanceCriteria: Stock reads live inventory; not-invoiced reads live orders
Both accept the shared filter layer and both export
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: report_access on /auth/me and CRM consumption
userStories.description: As a director, I want the CRM to know what a login may see, because today it assumes everyone is a director.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /auth/me returns a DERIVED report_access; it is never stored on the session
accessOf prefers user.report_access and falls back to the demo caps so offline and break-glass still work
The CRM reports screen reads the live endpoints and shows the masked-columns note
A masked table is visibly labelled partial, never silently short
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`
Gates green: `( cd atelier-crm && npm test && npm run build )`
